replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces dimensionality by projecting data onto orthogonal axes (principal components). **Steps:** 1) Standardize your dataset. 2) Compute covariance matrix. 3) Eigen-decompose to find eigenvalues/eigenvectors (PC directions).
